blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – On the 30th day of Vice President Sara Duterte impeachment trial, Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte may take the witness stand on Monday as the House prosecution panel seeks to establish the alleged unexplained wealth of his sister. Mayor Duterte is expected to testify after the cross-examination of Philippine Government Electronic Procurement System (PhilGEPS) Electronic Government Procurement Operations Division chief Rendell Sopeña. /dp READ: ICYMI: Sara Duterte impeachment trial Week 12 highlights /dp...
